title: Copa Microcentro
headlineMatchup: Defending champ Lucía Vega draws the rookie who cleared by 7cm in qualifiers.

title: Derby del Retroceso
headlineMatchup: The grudge rematch nobody touched a cone in last year. Both reversers are back.

title: Clásico del Cordón
headlineMatchup: The kerb-line classic. Sixteen drivers, one painted box, zero tolerance for a wheel on the line.

title: Gran Premio del Milímetro
headlineMatchup: The marquee night. The tightest sanctioned spaces of the season, down to single-digit centimeters.

title: Copa Nocturna
headlineMatchup: Headlights only. The deck lights cut to a single stadium wash and the parking gets quiet.

title: Final de Temporada
headlineMatchup: Eight reversers left. One title. The bracket that decides who tops the board into winter.

title: Apertura Primavera
headlineMatchup: The spring opener. New deck lights, new seeds, the same painted box that forgives nothing.

title: Copa de los Maestros
headlineMatchup: Veterans only. Every driver in the bracket has held a sanctioned record at least once.
